Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture (seed = case index) in both legs and compares the return value, the bytes of the fake objects, the touched global ranges, the x87 control word (24 bits) and the whole trace of doubled collaborators with raw arguments; foreign threads ignored. Traced doubles get NO credit. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source tested == current working tree at registration (class sources match the probe build manifest). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation. Limits: GXT texts well formed (every '~' closed, the EXE does not check NUL); GetRadioStationNameKey only with ids 0..13; StartRadio only with ids >= 0; Shutdown with a FindTxdSlot double that always returns a valid slot (the SafeRemoveTxdSlot(-1) branch is out); LoadFontValues with font id 0 or 1, complete sections and no real file (DATA\FONTS.DAT replaced by fixture lines); floats without signalling NaN; the real AERadioTrackManager is never touched, a fake 0x370-byte object is used; audio, CTxdStore, CFileMgr, CSprite2d, CStats, RNG and other collaborators doubled with trace (no credit).
